## Freeze Rules

- RVN-only, no non-token visual drift.
- 12px floor, no border radius.
- Composer is custom contenteditable (no textarea).
- Stream-first Chat V2 semantics remain authoritative.
- Node-scoped chat isolation is mandatory.
